text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...We boarded without a hitch.
Two stops until that botanical garden, was it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(More days have passed than I realized.
I wonder if the gentleman who gave me the rose is faring well?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I do hope the tea and confections are to your liking...)
choice_data_list: Huh, Lady Rose?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer, what a coincidence.
choice_data_list: If you were going out, I could have arranged a car for you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No. I wanted to take the train.
To experience the culture of everyday life and broaden my horizons.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The shifting scenery. The passengers engaged in cheerful conversation.
Every bit of it is utterly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that reminds me. When an opportune moment arises,
I intend to challenge the crowded commuter trains once more.
choice_data_list: ……Should that happen, I will protect you with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you getting off at this station as well?
choice_data_list: Yes, I had some business nearby.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As am I.
Then let us walk together part of the way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...What a curious coincidence.
To think we would be heading in the exact same direction.
choice_data_list: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............
Do you also have business at this botanical garden?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...What a coincidence.
To think we shared the exact same destination.
choice_data_list: Indeed... Haha.
Indeed... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is the matter?
choice_data_list: Pardon me, it's just that—

text_block_list.text:
Without either of them realizing it, they arrived at their destination,
tilting their heads in bewilderment. And that was...
choice_data_list: I just found it rather amusing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed.
Quite a laughable tale.
choice_data_list: Did you come here to view the roses, Lady Rose?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That is part of it. You as well?
choice_data_list: Yes, both for study and to feast my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As diligent as ever, I see.
However, this has reaffirmed my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If it is you, you can make them bloom.
...Flowers that rival even the roses here.

Whenever she speaks of cultivating roses, her expression softens, if only a little.
Each time I see that look on her face, my heart fills with joy.
choice_data_list: (I will surely nurture the rose entrusted to me to full bloom.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that must be the rose in question.
Distinctly crimson, and utterly commanding.
choice_data_list: Yes, even among the same red, it is distinct from the others.

text_block_list.text:
A flower reminiscent of my proud sovereign and her noble house. Whenever I gaze upon it, my resolve steels anew.
—To support the founding, and present a rose truly worthy of her kingdom.
choice_data_list: I, too, will make it bloom one day.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...That reminds me, Trainer. There is someone I would like you to meet.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for sharing
your roses with me the other day.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This is but a modest token, if you will accept it.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness, there is truly no need to be so courteous.
Just knowing you've taken an interest in cultivating roses brings me more joy than anything.
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, could this person perhaps be...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. He is the gentleman who bred the rose in question
and gifted me that single bloom.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you are cultivating it from a cutting.
I imagine it should be about time for new buds to emerge.
choice_data_list: Yes. Though small, just the other day, at long last.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
I am delighted to hear that. If you tend to them with love,
roses will surely answer in kind. Please take your time and care for them gently.
choice_data_list: Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Are there no further questions?
This is a rare opportunity. You should make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
If this old man can be of any help, please ask anything.
choice_data_list: How on earth do you cultivate such a rose?

text_block_list.text:
A beautiful plant that catches not only my eye, but that of my master as well.
I had been hoping to hear how it came to be.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I was curious about that as well.
...If you wouldn't mind sharing.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a simple thing, really.
Just steady, humble effort and plenty of trial and error.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text: The ideal rose cannot be achieved in a single generation. One must crossbreed carefully chosen cultivars, bringing color, fragrance, and petal form ever closer to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Breeding is a profound world—
I even overheard as much at the soiree.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Believing that through monumental effort, it can be achieved.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Failing to yield the desired color, or withering before it can properly grow...
It is by no means rare to be sent back to square one.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
Yet without ever giving up, after refining it across generations—
a long-sought, singular bloom is finally born.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling a long-held ambition across generations.
It is almost like...
choice_data_list: Just like the Rose clan, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So you thought so as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Inheriting their wishes, refining ourselves across generations,
all to reach our ultimate ideal.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just how arduous—
and how magnificent a feat that truly is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I... hold your great achievements in the highest reverence.

text_block_list.name: Botanical Garden Horticulturist
text_block_list.text:
I am merely an ordinary gardener.
I could never compare to one who bears the weight of the entire clan on the track.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Social standing has nothing to do with it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Treading a steep and arduous path to fulfill a long-cherished ambition.
It is only natural to pay respect to such an endeavor.
choice_data_list: (...Lady Rose is truly magnificent.)

text_block_list.text:
Never boastful, possessing the nobility to offer sincere respect to those she acknowledges—
I felt immense pride in serving someone with such grace.
choice_data_list: (If only to answer her devotion—)

text_block_list.text:
Is cultivating that rose truly enough to be my goal?
That was the ideal of an esteemed predecessor who stayed true to their convictions—it was never truly mine.
choice_data_list: (I want to cultivate my own rose and dedicate it to her.)
(I want to cultivate my own rose and dedicate it to her.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: We have gained some truly valuable insights.
choice_data_list: Yes, rose breeding is profound and difficult... and yet,

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: It made me want to cultivate my own ideal rose, too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once we return to the Academy, will you show me?
Your rose. The beginning of your ideal.

In my room—I gently showed Rose Kingdom
the rose cutting I had been nurturing in a corner of the balcony.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So that is a rose sprout.
...It is smaller than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This shall extend its branches, bear buds, and in time bloom into crimson flowers...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I hope your roses bloom beautifully as well.
choice_data_list: Yes, without a doubt.

text_block_list.text: Before the tender new sprout, a fresh vow was also quietly beginning to take root.
